Authoring workflow

Editor

The editor shell hosts world editing, asset browsing, Wings Assembler, Material editing, and Play/Stop validation.

Content Browser

Browse virtual folders for Meshes, Materials, Fragments, and Scenes. Context actions change by selected folder and asset type, including OBJ import from Meshes / Imported and safe deletion for unused project-owned assets.

Wings Assembler

Create reusable FragmentAssets from mesh nodes, pivots, transforms, materials, and root ComponentDefinitions.

Scene Editor

Place saved FragmentAssets into the world, edit transforms, and save placements into Scene assets.

Play / Stop

Play creates runtime actors. Stop removes runtime actors and restores authored state from the snapshot.

Tips

  • Open a project before authoring assets.
  • Use Wings Assembler for source Fragment changes.
  • Use World details for placed-instance transforms.
  • Delete is only available for unused project-owned assets, and there is no undo or Trash yet.
  • Runtime-spawned units are not saved into Scenes.
